caseName: Stevens v. Southern Pacific Land Co.
caseNameFull: Buell V. Stevens v. Southern Pacific Land Company Ralph E. Stevens, Administrator, etc. v. Southern Pacific Land Company and Mary V. Beggs v. Southern Pacific Land Company
attorneys: Mr. Daniel N. Clark and Mr. William L. Chitty for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Frank Thunen and Mr. C. F. R. Ogilby for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Baltimore & Potomac R. R. Co. v. Hopkins, 130 U. S. 210; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 6; Schaff v. Famechon Co., 258 U. S. 76.
